verdict.rationale: Numeral publishes a versioned API reference with per-endpoint pages (products, merchants, platform calculations, refunds, ping), but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. A static endpoint reference is related to this story but is not the interactive, runnable capability it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
